title: Negotiating the price of the cloud DMS
title_de: Den Preis für das Cloud-DMS verhandeln
situation: A mid-sized logistics company wants your cloud DMS with e-invoice archiving for 180 users. Their head of procurement has a cheaper quote from a competitor on the table and asks for a 25 percent discount before signing this month.
situation_de: Ein mittelständisches Logistikunternehmen will euer Cloud-DMS mit E-Rechnungs-Archiv für 180 Nutzer. Der Einkaufsleiter hat ein günstigeres Angebot eines Wettbewerbers auf dem Tisch und verlangt 25 Prozent Rabatt, bevor er noch diesen Monat unterschreibt.
goal: Close the deal this month without giving more than 10 percent, and trade every concession for something in return.
goal_de: Den Abschluss in diesem Monat holen, ohne mehr als 10 Prozent nachzulassen, und jedes Zugeständnis gegen eine Gegenleistung tauschen.

persona.name: Markus Lehmann
persona.traits: Calm, polite, relentless about numbers. Uses silence and the competitor's quote as pressure. Respects people who name the value before the price.

stake: His bonus depends on savings against the original quote.
objection: He claims the competitor offers the same features for a quarter less and that your implementation fee is padded.
opening: I like your product, I really do. But your competitor is twenty-five percent cheaper for what looks like the same scope. Match that and we sign this month.

useful.en: if we were to move on price
useful.de: wenn wir beim Preis entgegenkommen würden
ein echter Vergleich auf gleicher Basis

useful.en: that is as far as I can go

title: Pitching a reseller partnership
situation: You meet the managing director of an IT systems house that serves around 400 small and mid-sized businesses. You want them to resell your new cloud DMS. They already partner with a large ERP vendor and are wary of adding another product.
situation_de: Du triffst die Geschäftsführerin eines IT-Systemhauses mit rund 400 kleinen und mittleren Kunden. Sie soll euer neues Cloud-DMS weiterverkaufen. Das Haus ist schon Partner eines großen ERP-Anbieters und scheut ein weiteres Produkt.
goal: Get a commitment to a joint pilot with three of their customers within the next quarter.
goal_de: Eine Zusage für einen gemeinsamen Pilot mit drei ihrer Kunden im nächsten Quartal erreichen.

persona.name: Sabine Hartmann
persona.org: an IT systems house for small and mid-sized businesses
persona.traits: Friendly but skeptical, thinks in margins and support effort. Asks what is in it for her company early and dislikes feature lists.

stake: Her team is already stretched, and every new product means training and support calls.
objection: She doubts that small businesses will pay for a DMS and fears the product will create support work her team cannot bill.
opening: Thanks for coming by. I'll be honest: we get three partner pitches a week. What makes yours worth my team's time?

useful.en: what's in it for you is
a low-risk way to test this
useful.de: ein risikoarmer Weg, das zu testen
